title: Promoting occupational resilience: Testing and evaluation of a new psychosocial group programme at BTZ Rhein-Ruhr in phase 2
summary: The core offering of BTZ Rhein-Ruhr is occupational training. The aim of the training is to reintegrate people who want to return to work on the general labour market after suffering from mental illness and need help to do so. This applies in particular to phase 2 participants of the BTZ who are about to re-enter working life. While this can be challenging for those undergoing rehabilitation, it is extremely important for them to maintain their mental health in difficult professional situations by developing a high level of mental robustness – occupational resilience. Against this background, the aim of the project is to test and evaluate a new psychosocial group programme at BTZ Rhein-Ruhr to promote the occupational resilience of people undergoing rehabilitation (duration: 27 months). The assessment will focus on satisfaction with the new programme, the improvement in occupational resilience throughout the training (pre-post) and the stability of the training effects 3 (end of BTZ program) and 9 months after the training (follow-up, 6 months after end of BTZ program), as well as the effects on subjective reintegration prognosis and retention. A control group (treatment-as-usual) will be used to assess the corresponding effects.
conditions: The participants have heterogeneous F diagnoses, which have already been treated in advance as part of medical rehabilitation. The study is now focused on the area of occupational rehabilitation and addresses the question of how participation in working life can be supported.

interventions.name:
Intervention group: Occupational resilience training

Occupational resilience training is being introduced as part of a new psychosocial group programme at the BerufsTrainingsZentrum (BTZ) Rhein-Ruhr im Standort Oberhausen. The training comprises six sessions, each lasting approximately two hours.
Control group: Standard group at BTZ Rhein-Ruhr (no training)

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
Participants in phase 2 of the BTZ-program at the BTZ Rhein-Ruhr
Exclusion criteria:
Lack of consent to study
